task: #170 onSubmit payload classifier (is_definitely_not_callable, #167) does not cover record/tuple/list literal payloads -- only Expr::Ctor and scalar leaves. A record/tuple/list literal onSubmit payload would ALSO be non-callable (HtmlOnSubmit's payload type is genuinely unconstrained per constrain.rs's HtmlEventShape::Raw scheme) but is not classified as such, so it stays on the old wrap-and-call path and would still fail cargo build with the same class of error #167 fixed for bare Ctors.
notes: Found during #167's independent adversarial review. NOT a regression -- this exact shape was ALREADY broken before #167 (no prior working behavior to preserve) and is essentially unreachable in a real Sky.Live app (the view tree pins msg to one concrete type, so a record/tuple/list literal happening to unify with a real onSubmit handler's Msg type is very unlikely in practice). Low priority, not blocking.
